tasks.title: Fix Task Assignment Implementation
tasks.description: The createTask function accepts an 'assignedTo' parameter but always sets 'Assigned To' to an empty array. Implement proper assignment logic to either map the assignedTo parameter to Notion people objects or use an alternative field type (e.g., select or rich_text) if people field is not appropriate for agent assignments.
acceptance_criteria: Task assignments are correctly stored in Notion
Function handles both agent and human assignments
Error handling for invalid assignment values
tasks.implementation_notes: Consider whether agents should be represented as Notion users or if a text-based field would be more appropriate. May need to update Notion database schema.

tasks.title: Add Task Retrieval Function
tasks.description: Implement a function to retrieve task details by page ID. This is essential for querying current task state before updates and for general task management workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Function retrieves task by page ID
tasks.implementation_notes: Use notion.pages.retrieve() API method. Return normalized task object for easier consumption.

tasks.title: Add Task Query/List Function
tasks.description: Implement a function to query and list tasks from the Notion database with filtering capabilities (by status, assignee, date range, etc.). This enables comprehensive task management and reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Function queries database with optional filters
Supports filtering by status, assignee, and date
tasks.implementation_notes: Use notion.databases.query() API method. Implement filter builder for common query patterns.

tasks.title: Expand Status Options
tasks.description: Extend the task status options beyond 'To-do' and 'Done' to include intermediate states like 'In Progress', 'Blocked', 'Review', and 'Cancelled'. This provides better task lifecycle tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Status enum includes all standard workflow states
updateTask function accepts new status values
Notion database schema supports new statuses

technical_requirements.external_changes: Notion database status property must be updated

tasks.implementation_notes: Requires manual update to Notion database status field options. Document all available statuses and their meanings.

tasks.title: Add Task Deletion Function
tasks.description: Implement a function to archive or delete tasks. Notion API moves pages to trash rather than permanently deleting them, which provides safety.
acceptance_criteria: Function archives task by page ID
Confirmation mechanism to prevent accidental deletion
tasks.implementation_notes: Use notion.pages.update() with archived: true property. Consider soft delete vs hard delete requirements.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
tasks.description: Enhance error handling throughout the codebase with specific error types, retry logic for transient failures, and structured error responses. Current implementation only logs errors without proper classification or recovery mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Custom error classes for different failure types
Retry logic for rate limits and network errors
Structured error responses with error codes
Error logging with appropriate severity levels
tasks.implementation_notes: Handle Notion API rate limits (3 requests/second), authentication errors, validation errors, and network failures separately.

tasks.title: Add Input Validation
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive input validation for all function parameters to prevent invalid API calls and provide clear error messages. Validate required fields, data types, and value constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Clear error messages for invalid inputs
Length and format validation where applicable

technical_requirements.new_dependencies: Consider validation library like joi or zod

tasks.implementation_notes: Validate task titles (non-empty, max length), page IDs (format), status values (enum), and other inputs before API calls.

tasks.title: Create Configuration Module
tasks.description: Extract configuration logic into a separate module with validation, default values, and clear error messages for missing environment variables. Current implementation silently fails if environment variables are not set.
acceptance_criteria: Clear error messages for missing config
Support for optional configuration with defaults
tasks.implementation_notes: Export validated configuration object. Fail fast on missing required environment variables with helpful error messages.

tasks.title: Add Unit Tests
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive unit tests for all functions using a testing framework like Jest or Mocha. Mock Notion API calls to enable testing without live API access.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use jest.mock() to mock @notionhq/client. Test both success and failure paths. Set up test database or use fixtures.

tasks.title: Add Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create integration tests that verify actual Notion API interactions using a test database. These tests should run optionally (when credentials are provided) to validate real API behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests with real Notion API
Tests can be skipped if no credentials
tasks.implementation_notes: Use environment variables like NOTION_TEST_API_KEY. Clean up created tasks after tests. Document test database schema requirements.

tasks.title: Add Logging Infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement structured logging with configurable log levels (debug, info, warn, error) and optional JSON output for log aggregation systems. Replace console.log/error with proper logging.
acceptance_criteria: Configurable log level via environment variable
tasks.implementation_notes: Use pino for performance. Ensure API keys and sensitive data are never logged. Add request ID correlation.

tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Documentation
tasks.description: Expand README.md with setup instructions, API documentation, usage examples, troubleshooting guide, and Notion database schema requirements. Add JSDoc comments to all functions.
tasks.implementation_notes: Include screenshots of Notion setup. Document common error scenarios. Provide complete example usage patterns.

tasks.title: Add CLI Interface
tasks.description: Create a command-line interface for common operations (create, update, list, delete tasks) to enable manual testing and scripting. Use a CLI framework like commander or yargs.
acceptance_criteria: CLI commands for all core operations
tasks.implementation_notes: Make cli.js executable. Add bin entry in package.json. Support --help and --version flags. Use chalk for colored output.

tasks.title: Implement Rate Limiting and Retry Logic
tasks.description: Add client-side rate limiting to respect Notion API limits (3 requests/second) and implement exponential backoff retry logic for transient failures and rate limit errors.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use p-queue for rate limiting. Implement exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s. Make retry count configurable via environment variable.

tasks.title: Add GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Set up GitHub Actions workflow for automated testing, linting, and optional deployment. Include unit tests, integration tests (with secrets), and code quality checks.
acceptance_criteria: Runs on pull requests and main branch
tasks.implementation_notes: Use Node.js test matrix (LTS versions). Cache node_modules. Run integration tests only if secrets are configured. Add ESLint for code quality.
